name: California Solar & Electric Inc.
about:
California Solar & Electric is based in Valencia, California. The company highlights 15 years of industry experience, with owner Chris leading the business.

The firm designs and installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, including rooftop, ground-mounted, and battery backup installations using products such as Tesla Powerwall and Enphase microinverters. An in-house team of certified solar professionals handles each project from custom design through permitting, installation, and system activation. The company also offers financing options including cash purchase, loans, leases, and power purchase agreements.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills to businesses such as offices and manufacturing facilities looking for scalable energy solutions. All projects are located within California.

California Solar & Electric emphasizes its status as a certified installer for brands including REC Solar, Unirac, Qcells, Enphase, Franklin, and Tesla. The company backs every installation with 25-year warranties covering equipment, workmanship, and performance, and promotes a five-step process from free consultation to system monitoring.
